facts.fact: 当天下午 Helena 在 Clothier de Denue 对街等候，看到 Madame Leóne 抱着裙子走向店门后上前问好，自称「来支持你」并随她进店——实际上是来护送 Madame Leóne、不让她的地址落入 Grenault 之手，手一直按在弩上以防万一。
facts.quote:
I  waited  across  the  street  from Clothier  de


Denue that afternoon, watching until I saw Madame Leóne march toward the front door. She had a clear bounce  to  her  step  as  she  approached,  cradling  her beautiful dresses.


I  strode  toward  her  with  equal  purpose.


“Madame Leóne,” I greeted.


She turned, looking delighted. “Helena! What


a lovely surprise! What are you doing here?”


“I—just came by to support you,” I said. “Oh, how wonderful!” she said, hugging me.

She  threw  her  arm around  me  to escort  me


inside.  Though,  in  fact,  I  was  here  to  escort  her.  I didn’t  know  what  I  would  say  to  keep  her  and  her address safe from Grenault, but I kept a hand on my crossbow, if all else failed

facts.fact: 酒馆老板 Gerard Touraine 向 Helena 透露：Grenault 最近几个小时一直在向店里其他桌的陌生人（不是他常来的那伙人）打听谁能帮忙制作弩箭，今天还在镇上四处打听；要求「做得快、量大、能拿到银、有熔银设施」；Touraine 说 He's hunting you, Mademoiselle。Grenault 已把范围缩小到两处——银匠铺 L'atelier de Forgeron de Filliene 和一家铁匠铺（Touraine 说到 L'atelier– 时被 Helena 惊呼补全为 L'atelier de Forgeron de Leóne）；Touraine 确认 He's found you, Mademoiselle。
